_z3A1: [pleading] Sifu... whatever it is, please... drive it out. I'll do anything you say.
_md3A1: [calmly, reassuring] Don't be afraid. Kneel down. Close your eyes. I will settle it for you.
_z3A3: [quietly] I didn't ask what it was. I didn't want to know. I only wanted someone to take it away.
_as3A: [kindly] Sifu says come back seven nights, same time. And this one... paste it above your bed, okay?
_z3A2: [weary] Seven nights, I went back. I drank what he gave me. I pasted the talisman over my bed. He did everything he knew to help me... and I believed every word, because believing was easier than asking.
_md3A3: [warmly] Should be alright now. Go home. Rest well.
_z3A4: [shaken] But it didn't stop. Not really. And I had nothing left to ask with... only an answer I had never once questioned.
_z3A5: [reflective] I had handed my question to someone else... and stopped looking, just when I should have started.
_z3B1: [firm, dismissive] No. You're wrong. It's not a ghost. I would know.
_md3B1: [calmly] Maybe. I can only tell you what I see.
_md3B2: [kindly] Whatever it is, it is strong. Take this... for your protection.
_md3B3: [gently] Okay. If you change your mind, my door is always open.
_z3B2: [defiant] I walked out sure of myself. A ghost? I knew what I felt...
_z3B4: [shaken] ...but I didn't. I couldn't prove it wasn't a ghost. I couldn't prove anything at all.
_z3B5: [ashamed] He had only been trying to help me. I threw away the one answer I had... and had nothing to put in its place.
_z3B6: [reflective] It took me a long time to swallow my pride... and go looking for answers properly.
_z3C1: [respectfully] Thank you, Sifu. I'll think carefully about what you said.
_md3C: [kindly] Mm. Keep this talisman with you. If it comes again, come back and see me.
_z3C2: [uncertain] A ghost... He sounded so sure. But I'd felt it dance for the Buddha... I needed someone else to tell me what it was.
_z3C3: [quietly] The next morning, I went back to the shop.
_ow3C1: [warm, concerned] Ah, you came back! You okay or not? So... what did the sifu say?
_z3C4: [hesitant] He said... it could be a ghost.
_ow3C2: [thoughtful] Ghost? Hm... Sifu is good, but I don't think so lah. Yesterday you danced for the Buddha. The whole shop saw. A ghost won't pay respect like that. I think something good is looking after you. Maybe a Thevada.
_z3C5: [thoughtful] One said a ghost. One said a Thevada. Both kind... both so sure. They couldn't both be right... and they could both be wrong.
_z3C6: [reflective] Asking around gave me more answers... but none of them were mine yet.
_z3D1: [respectfully] Sifu... may I ask you something? When you said ghost... it became angry. Why would it do that?
_md3D2: [sincerely] I read it the way my teachers taught me... through my god, in my tradition. Another master, the Thai side, may read it another way.
_z3D2: [quietly] He had given me his answer honestly... and told me himself it might not be the only one.
_z3D3: [thoughtful] A ghost? A Thevada? Hanuman? I couldn't prove it was a ghost. I couldn't prove it wasn't. I couldn't even prove it was something else entirely.
_z3D4: [resolved, quietly] What I realised that night was simple. I couldn't just accept the first explanation I was handed. If I wanted the truth... I had to go and seek it, learn it, and find it for myself.
_z3A: I handed it all to him... and stopped asking.
_z3B: I told him he was wrong. I couldn't say what was right.
_z3C: I asked for a second opinion, and got a second certainty.
_z3D: I asked him honestly, and went to find the truth myself.
_z3roar: [strained, overwhelmed] I feel something... roaring through me...  (v21.30, Chad: "during the orbit duration, add a player voiceline saying, 'i feel something roaring through me...' then the lunge and roar happens")
